name: snowflake-arctic-embed-l-v2.0

usage_examples.title: Embed text
usage_examples.code:
curl -X POST http://localhost:8082/embed \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model": "Snowflake/snowflake-arctic-embed-l-v2.0", "input": ["search query text"]}'
